name: billingengine-mcp
description: MCP server for BillingEngine: create customers and invoices, look up invoices and record payments from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.
author: Timo Kleemann

scripts.bundle: npm run build && esbuild dist/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=mcpb/server/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && mcpb pack mcpb billingengine.mcpb
